scenes.prompt: Image1 is edit target; image2 ONLY provides BLACK FOX at left. Preserve hooded character, dark hoodie, pose, anatomy, furniture, laptop/monitor perspective, all surroundings and pixel style. REMOVE the black fox emblem from EVERY prop (case, bench, backpack, cabinet, device). Put one small BLACK FOX as a stitched patch on the hoodie's naturally visible upper sleeve, with a restrained light edge so it reads against dark fabric. It follows sleeve folds/perspective; never turn body or any prop to show the patch. No owl. Do not change any hand, limb, foot or equipment, or add text. Keep exact aspect ratio and clean transparent outside margin.
